cancel() called by the order's maker always marks the order's hash as cancelled, while cancel() by anyone else always reverts and leaves state unchanged.

Calling setFee with a value of 30 or more always reverts and leaves the contract's fee unchanged.
Calling setBaseURI (by the owner) always stores exactly the given string as the contract's baseURI.

cancel(order) reverts exactly when order.maker != msg.sender, and otherwise marks cancelledOrders[hashOrder(order)] as cancelled.
hashOppositeOrder(order) equals hashOrder of the same order with isLong flipped.
